I waited until Day 9 to do this one because getting sober, and getting comfortable staying in sobriety, can take 100% of your willpower at first. If you are at Day 2 or less, you get a pass on this exercise for now. Put your effort into getting dry, and come back when you're ready.

If you were drinking heavily before, what are some neglected things that you need to catch up on?

Cleaning is a great place to start. You may have sweated boozy sweat into your sheets, spilt drops of beer onto your desk, or alowed you bathroom to become disgusting. It could be something else entirely that you've neglected. Deferred maintainance, appointments or accounts that need to be set up, work and family matters...even neglected hygiene. Each day try to think of one thing that you've neglected that you now are starting to have the time, energy, and clarity to take care of. You'll feel a bit better for each task that you handle. What is the next thing for you?

While you're starting to have more time and energy, do take it easy when catching up. If you replace all your your bad habits with chores all at once, your subconsious mind will fight you back. Balance out your return to healthier behavior with rest and recreation.
